judge_panel.reason: The paper states 'all prompt-based methods use an identical prompt protocol across experiments' but never specifies what that protocol actually is (e.g., ground-truth bounding boxes, points, grid of points). This leaves the exact prompting strategy unspecified, making reproducibility and fairness of comparison unclear, though the reviewer's concern about data leakage is speculative rather than demonstrated.

The paper only states that "SAM is evaluated in a zero-shot setting, while all prompt-based methods use an identical prompt protocol across experiments," but it never specifies what that protocol actually is (e.g., points, boxes, masks, automatic vs. ground-truth-derived prompts). Figure 2 labels a "Prompt Encoder," yet no text defines the prompts, so the setup is not reproducible from the paper alone.

The paper states that "all prompt-based methods use an identical prompt protocol across experiments" (Section IV.B) but fails to define what this protocol actually entails (e.g., whether it uses ground-truth bounding boxes, point prompts, or a uniform grid).
